en: Grunt
Come on, give us a dance! What, you won't dance for Team Rocket? Then I'll take that Eevee off your hands instead!
text: Hai, dansează pentru noi! Ce, nu dansezi pentru Echipa Rocket? Atunci îți iau Eevee-ul ăla!

en: Kimono Girl
Please, stop it! Somebody, help!
Grunt
Who asked you? Team Rocket goes where it likes and takes what it wants. Get lost, or get hurt!
text: Cine te-a întrebat? Echipa Rocket merge unde vrea și ia ce vrea. Dispari, sau o pățești!

en: Tch! Whatever. Dancing's boring anyway. I'm out of here!
text: Ț! Fie. Oricum dansul e plictisitor. Am plecat!

en: Kimono Girl
Thank you for saving me. My Eevee and I would have been so frightened without you.
text: Îți mulțumesc că m-ai salvat. Eevee și cu mine am fi fost tare speriați fără tine.

en: That man won't leave me alone. Please, can't somebody make him go away?
text: Omul ăla nu mă lasă în pace. Vă rog, nu-l poate face cineva să plece?

en: Kimono Girl
That feather... a Rainbow Wing! Then you may be the one the bird of the Bell Tower is waiting for.
We are the tower's dancers. Before we let anyone climb it, the five of us test them, one after another.
There will be no rest between us. Are you ready?
Zuki
I'm first. Don't hold back!
Naoko
Zuki's fallen? Then it's my turn to dance.
Miki
You helped me once. Now let me see how strong you really are.
Sayo
Three of us, and you're still standing. Then try me.
Kuni
I'm the last. If you pass me, the tower is yours to climb.
Kimono Girl
Five battles, and not one rest. You and your Pokémon are one heart. We are sure of it now.
We will go ahead to the Bell Tower and tell the Sages at its gate to let you pass. Meet us at the very top.
Kimono Girl
Not yet, it seems. Rest your Pokémon, and come back to us. We'll test you again from the beginning.
Gentleman
I never miss a performance. My Psyduck enjoys it as much as I do.
text: Nu ratez niciun spectacol. Psyduck-ului meu îi place la fel de mult ca mie.

en: Surf lets a Pokémon carry you over the water. With the Fog Badge, you'll be able to use it outside of battle.
text: Cu Surf, un Pokémon te poartă peste apă. Cu Insigna Ceață, o să-l poți folosi în afara luptei.

en: Gentleman
That was splendid! You stood up to that ruffian when the rest of us only watched. I'm ashamed of myself.
text: A fost splendid! I-ai ținut piept bădăranului, când noi ceilalți doar ne-am uitat. Mi-e rușine de mine.

en: Please, accept this. It's a technique I treasure, but you'll put it to far better use.
text: Te rog, primește asta. E o tehnică la care țin mult, dar tu o vei folosi mult mai bine.

en: That's Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water once you have Morty's Fog Badge.
text: Asta e Surf. Un Pokémon care o știe te poate purta peste apă, după ce ai Insigna Ceață a lui Morty.
